title: PostReady: PR #522 — Video source-frame QC: best-of-3 frames judged by vision
description: AI-generated video QC: renders 3 candidate source frames in parallel, uses GPT-4o vision to inspect each for hands/fingers, faces, limbs, and artifacts, then animates the cleanest frame. Wall-clock unchanged (parallel); adds ~/bin/bash.06/video. VIDEO_FRAME_CANDIDATES env flag (default 3, set 1 to disable). Fail-soft: any QC failure falls back to first frame. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #520 — Landing page: Create · Save · Post section cleanup
description: Cleaned up the landing page Create → Save → Post section for clearer messaging and visual consistency. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #519 — Video Phase 0+1: single-clip progress, cost + timings, VIDEO_MODEL seam
description: Shipped Video Phase 0+1: single-clip upload progress indicator, cost + timings display, and VIDEO_MODEL seam to abstract the video provider. Consolidates PRs #514 and #515. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #512 — Tab-aware shapes hint on the Create page
description: Added a tab-aware shapes hint on the Create page to guide users toward available shape/framing options based on the active tab context. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #511 — Save lands on the Post Packs grid (final answer)
description: After several iterations (PR #508 sent to pack list, PR #509 reverted to pack page), save now lands on the Post Packs grid — the definitive UX decision. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #510 — Richer Pro Prompt structure + auto-seed Prompt Studio from typed idea
description: Enhanced Pro Prompt with a richer 5-layer structure (ambition, setting with signature detail, people/energy, lighting, composition/framing) and auto-seeds Prompt Studio from the user's typed idea, reducing friction at prompt-writing entry. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #509 — Revert #508: save returns to the pack page
description: Reverted PR #508 (save landing on Post Packs list) — save now returns to the pack page as before. Quick course-correction shipped Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #508 — After saving a generated image, land on the Post Packs list
description: UX improvement: after saving a generated image, the user is now redirected to the Post Packs list instead of staying on the current page. Merged Jul 15.

title: PostReady: PR #507 — Replace GPT double hyphens with em dashes in generated copy
description: Copy quality fix: GPT-generated post text now correctly uses em dashes (—) instead of double hyphens (--). Improves readability and typographic polish across all generated content. Merged Jul 14.

title: PostReady: PR #506 — Poll Mux for SDR MP4 (fix HDR swap never firing)
description: Fixed a race condition where the Mux HDR→SDR swap was silently never firing. Switched to polling Mux for the SDR MP4 asset to ensure HDR normalization actually completes before publish. Merged Jul 14.
